$comment: Model ids and prices (USD per 1M tokens, Anthropic first-party API). Maintained by hand. The runner, pricing engine and web read this file; nothing hardcodes a model id. cache_* rates follow Anthropic's standard prompt-caching multipliers (read = 0.1x input, write = 1.25x input) unless a model publishes a different rate.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.notes: Default for the paid tier. Best at cross-file logic and economic attack paths.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.notes: Best value. Strong on checklist compliance and pattern-matchable items.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast grep-heavy scan. Will miss logic bugs; suitable for CI-style passes.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.5
models.notes: Previous generation. Kept for reports produced by hand before this platform existed; not offered for new runs.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.1
models.notes: Disabled by default: highest cost. Enable if you want to offer a maximum-depth tier.
